info.title: Miami-Dade School Navigator API
info.description:
Map-based school navigator for Miami-Dade County (infancy to 12th grade). Every metric is a `Field` with status, source, url, as_of and method; missing data is returned as `not_available` with a reason and a next step. Data: Miami-Dade County GIS, FLDOE, curated rules (see /api/meta/quality).

**Language.** Send `X-Lang: en | es | ht` on any request (or `?lang=`, which wins over the header) and the API writes its own text (notes, `why` / `suggested_action` explanations, score reasons, questions to ask, compare labels, errors) in English, Spanish or Haitian Creole. Missing or unknown values mean English. `POST /api/plan` and `POST /api/chat` also take a `lang` body field, which wins for that request. `Field.method` is translated, but `verification: <level>` and the `Check:` marker inside it stay literal. `source`, `url`, school and place names, addresses and data values are never translated. The Spanish and Haitian Creole texts are AI-written and have not been reviewed by a native speaker; English is authoritative.

parameters.name: priorities

schema.description: csv; boosts the match score without filtering
schema.title: Priorities

parameters.description: csv; boosts the match score without filtering

parameters.name: values

schema.description: csv of what matters most, from academics,programs,popularity,proximity; counts those factors extra in the match score without filtering
schema.title: Values

parameters.description: csv of what matters most, from academics,programs,popularity,proximity; counts those factors extra in the match score without filtering

parameters.name: q

schema.description: school-name text filter (use a large radius_mi to search the whole county)
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: school-name text filter (use a large radius_mi to search the whole county)

get.description: Find schools by name across the whole county, best match first. Used by the map's search box to jump to a school.
What graduates of this school go on to do: college and employment trend, course participation, notable alumni. Empty lists where a source has nothing.
The split of alumni answers for a school (once enough people answered), and the caller's own answer if signed in.

put.description: Add or change your own answer for a school. Signed-in only; one answer per person per school.

token.title: Token
token.description: Opaque session token: send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Unix time when the session ends.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Notes Jarvis kept from earlier chats (preferences, worries, schools the family liked), in short sentences. The app stores them on the family's device and sends them back.

ChatProfile.title: ChatProfile
ChatProfile.description: What the family has already told us. Held for the request only; the server stores nothing (the app keeps it on the family's device).

map_available.title: Map Available
map_available.description: True when the chat is shown next to the map, so Jarvis may change the map filters (reply `map_update`).

map_next.title: Map Next
map_next.description: True when the map is on the next page (the onboarding chat): Jarvis offers to show the results on the map and, when asked, returns `map_update` so the app opens the map with those filters.

map_filters.title: Map Filters
map_filters.description: The family's current map search (radius_mi, kinds, stage, free_only, grade_min, specialties, ese, priorities, values, sort, limit). Jarvis's school searches default to it, so the schools it names are the schools on the map.

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language of the answer. Omit to use the X-Lang header (English when absent). Translations are AI-written and not yet reviewed by a native speaker.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Model calls and tokens used by this turn (for quota monitoring).

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the AI model was unavailable and only structured results are returned.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Where Jarvis's school search was centred (lat, lon, label, precision) when the family asked about a place other than their own location, so the app can move the map there.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: True when this answer was served from the answer cache instead of being generated again.

profile_update.title: Profile Update
profile_update.description: Details the family told Jarvis in the chat, for the app to keep on their device: `children` (the full list of {name, age}). Set only when they mentioned a child.

map_update.title: Map Update
map_update.description: Filters the family asked Jarvis to put on the map (radius_mi, kinds, free_only, grade_min, programs, only_programs, ese, values, view, kid, reset). Set only when they asked for a change.

children.title: Children
children.description: The family's children (age, optional name). Not stored.

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: False returns only the instant grade-fit sentence, without calling the language model.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: 1-2 short sentences per child on why this school could fit, in the request language.

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: True when the language model wrote it; false for the grade-fit sentence built from the child's age and the school's grades.

entering.title: Entering
entering.description: What the child is doing in the planning year, e.g. 'Kindergarten', 'VPK (Pre-K 4)', 'Grade 2', 'Past 12th grade'.

with_outcome_data.title: With Outcome Data
with_outcome_data.description: Graduates the state could find an outcome for; the percentages below are shares of this.

enrolled_pct.title: Enrolled Pct
enrolled_pct.description: Enrolled in any college or postsecondary program.

employed_pct.title: Employed Pct
employed_pct.description: Employed in Florida (can overlap with enrolled).

radius_mi.title: Radius Mi
radius_mi.description: Travel distance used for the distance part of the match score.

scores.title: Scores
scores.description: Match score and per-factor points for each school, same order as `schools`. Empty without a location.

best_index.title: Best Index
best_index.description: Only set for numeric official fields where more is better.

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: False when computed from age only; the September 1 cut-off then makes it an estimate.

year.title: Year
year.description: School year the child first qualifies, for result=later.

source.title: Source
source.description: Dataset or rule the value comes from (for not_available: where we looked).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date the underlying data is current to (or was retrieved).

method.title: Method
method.description: How the value was obtained or computed.

why.title: Why
why.description: not_available only: why the value is missing.

suggested_action.title: Suggested Action
suggested_action.description: not_available only: what the family can do next.

applicable.title: Applicable
applicable.description: False when the item does not apply to this kind of school (e.g. state grades for a private school): the value is missing by design, not for lack of data. Only set on not_available fields.

Field.title: Field
Field.description: One value plus where it came from.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 0-1. Address-point matches are high; a ZIP centroid is deliberately low.

schools_nearby.title: Schools Nearby
schools_nearby.description: Private schools within 5 miles whose FLDOE directory entry lists this program.

days_until.title: Days Until
days_until.description: Negative once the date has passed.

distance_mi.title: Distance Mi
distance_mi.description: Straight-line miles from the lat/lon given, when one was.

total.title: Total
total.description: How many schools match; `results` holds the best few.

applies.title: Applies
applies.description: False for child care and other places with no K-12 grades, where this section does not make sense.

empty_reason.title: Empty Reason
empty_reason.description: Why a K-12 school has no outcome data, in the request language. Set only when every list is empty.

alumni.title: Alumni
alumni.description: Up to 12 notable alumni. Notable people only: not a representative sample.

match_score.title: Match Score
match_score.description: 0-100 match score, the same one /schools uses. Options are ordered by it.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why this school scored well, from the score's own factors.

score_breakdown.title: Score Breakdown
score_breakdown.description: Points earned and possible for each factor behind match_score.

radius_mi.title: Radius Mi
radius_mi.description: How far the family will travel; only schools within it are suggested.

priorities.title: Priorities
priorities.description: Programs the family wants (STEM, Arts, ...); same meaning as on /schools.

values.title: Values
values.description: What matters most (academics, programs, popularity, proximity); same meaning as on /schools.

age.title: Age
age.description: Age today. Ignored when birth_date is given.

birth_date.title: Birth Date
birth_date.description: Optional. Exact eligibility depends on the September 1 cut-off, so a birth date gives exact answers; without it everything is estimated from age and labelled so.

field.description: Provenance of the main claim in `detail` (curated rule with its verification level, or an official/derived data field).

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language of the generated text. Omit to use the X-Lang header (English when absent). Translations are AI-written and not yet reviewed by a native speaker; English is authoritative.

pct.title: Pct
pct.description: Share of the school's whole enrollment.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: online_school: a virtual school with no campus to visit (its distance is only the office address). grade_match_unverified: the state grade was joined on a school number whose official names differ; confirm it is the same school.

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: How many candidates each hard filter removed.

data_available.title: Data Available
data_available.description: Which optional datasets are loaded, e.g. state_grades, learning_gains, scholarship_flags, magnet_themes, ese_signals; lets a client disable a filter that cannot match.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name, shown in the header after sign-in.

grad_year.title: Grad Year
grad_year.description: The year they graduated or left. Optional.

enough.title: Enough
enough.description: False until `min_responses` people answered; the split is withheld until then.

breakdown.title: Breakdown
breakdown.description: Share of answers per field, largest first. Empty until `enough`.

mine.description: The signed-in person's own answer, if any.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One or two short sentences on why this school is a good match, in the request language. Empty when there is nothing to say.

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: True when the language model wrote it; false when it was built from the match score's own reasons (model unavailable).

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: Matching id in /api/schools, when the school is in the database.

features.title: Features
features.description: Each feature: a (Multi)Polygon plus properties level, school_name, school_source_id, place_id, source, url, as_of, method.

ZoneShapes.title: ZoneShapes
ZoneShapes.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the attendance zones that contain a location, for drawing on a map.
